# CompositeParticleRenderer

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Particles` · record

```csharp
public sealed record CompositeParticleRenderer : ParticleRenderer
```

Types: [`ParticleRenderer`](ParticleRenderer.md)

Draws the same particles with each of several renderers in turn, for example a soft glow under a crisp core. Create one with [`ParticleRenderer.Composite`](ParticleRenderer.md#composite).

## Remarks

Every renderer draws into the same batch, so the effect has one blend mode: a glow that needs additive blending under a normal core is two effects.
